Definition: from G1537 and G2989; to be resplendent:--shine forth.
BiblicalUsage: This word means to shine forth, to be resplendent, and Jesus uses it once, at the end of the parable of the wheat and the tares. Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father, He says, and the sentence ends with the call to hear. The word is the brightness of the harvest, when the wheat is finally seen for what it is.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the righteous will shine, because Jesus says so, and the day of harvest will show what the world could not see.
